metadata.methodology: Separates public cloud providers, CDN/edge networks, application PaaS, frontend hosting, serverless/FaaS, VM hosting and hosting-control platforms. The Stack Overflow 2025 'cloud development' question mixes several of these layers, so source percentages are not treated as cloud market share.
metadata.integrity_note: Popularity/adoption metrics are source-specific. Missing country/gender fields are intentionally not inferred.
